description: Inspects or edits a saved workflow: an outline, one function's source, targeted function or step edits, a settings patch. copy_to keeps a linked copy on Writ Cloud or the user's desktop. Every option: writ_help('writ_update_workflow').

function_updates.description: Targeted edits of one function: [{function_name, patch | json_edits | script_edits}].

patch.description: Settings and metadata to change; {"name": "New name"} renames it.

step_updates.description: [{index, patch}] merged into those recorded steps.

validate_only.description: true previews and validates; nothing is saved.

workflow.description: Name or id; local:<n> for a desktop workflow.

name: writ_update_workflow
title: Edit a saved workflow
